action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (0.97) and strong seasonality (0.72) making it highly predictable, but the model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.885, only 1 independent group). With only 3 validation windows, fitted weights carry high estimation variance. The weighted combination (w1) already captures the best available signal from the full pool without overfitting to the unstable per-window ranking, and the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable. Accepting the seed leader is the robust choice.
